title: Wind-driven onset: Veron–Wagner comparison
status_text: A wind-driven shear layer at physical age 16 seconds, followed for six seconds with prescribed or evolving 3 cm waves. Validation and submission are being prepared.

validation.description: Validation is being prepared; job identifier will follow.

cases.title: Coupled parent and current
cases.description: The parent waves and the wave-averaged current act on each other. Cho follows the evolving parent and surface current.

cases.title: Without current feedback to the parent
cases.description: The parent retains its intrinsic evolution. Current feedback to the parent is disabled; Cho still feels the parent and surface current.

notes: A wind-driven shear layer at physical age 16 seconds, followed for six seconds with prescribed or evolving 3 cm waves.
